identity.summary: Brand Ninja Van = NINJA LOGISTICS PTE. LTD., UEN 201412014E, live, incorporated 25 Apr 2014, 438A Alexandra Road #07-01 Alexandra Technopark. Linked by RecordOwl (ACRA-sourced) saying it operates under brand Ninja Van, and by Indeed/Foundit/MyCareersFuture listings of Ninja Logistics Pte Ltd Warehouse Supervisor roles.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search for the legal name returned registry aggregators directly
identity.what_was_missing: Did not read ACRA itself; other Singapore group entities not checked

business_and_headcount.summary: Tech-enabled last-mile/B2B restocking/cold chain; six markets (SG, MY, ID, VN, PH, TH); founders Lai Chang Wen, Shaun Chong, Boxian Tan. No SG headcount found (CNA said it asked company).

financial_performance.summary: FY2025 revenue down 3% to US$702m (second straight decline), losses narrowed 31%; reported plan to raise ~US$80m at roughly halved valuation; peak unicorn. Figures from Tech in Asia headline/summary via secondary BEAMSTART; Tech in Asia page itself unreadable.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Primary financials; still loss-making; Tech in Asia paywall/JS

layoffs_restructuring.summary: Aug 2025: ~12% of Singapore staff cut, severance per tripartite advisory, even for <2 years service; earlier rounds Apr 2024 (regional tech) and Jul 2024 (Singapore staff). Headquarters streamlining to focus on B2B restocking and cold chain.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Many independent outlets returned; CNA extracted fully
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Absolute numbers; whether warehouse ops affected (cuts described as HQ)

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Glassdoor SG 3.3/5 from 195 reviews (worldwide 3.2); snippets mention friendly colleagues but some toxic leadership, stressful peak periods. Jobstreet summary: independence, supportive team; pay could be better, physically demanding in heat. Review text itself not read.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Snippets carried ratings and AI summaries
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Glassdoor extract failed; Indeed gave sign-in page; no warehouse-supervisor specific sentiment

pay_and_benefits.summary: No Ninja Van supervisor pay figure read. Generic SG warehouse supervisor average about S$67-68k/yr (SalaryExpert snippets). Company-specific Indeed/Jobstreet/Glassdoor salary pages exist but not readable. Benefits: only layoff-package details (medical, mental health support, stock options).

interview_and_hiring.summary: Glassdoor lists 175 interview reviews; snippet says warehouse process = screening call then face-to-face/virtual interview, questions on inventory, safety, teamwork. Open Night Shift Warehouse Supervisor listing on Indeed/Foundit/MyCareersFuture.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No Ninja Van-specific scam or MOM action found in one search. Zaobao Aug 2026 reports scammers impersonating courier companies by SMS (not stated to be Ninja Van specifically; inferred relevant only as a general caution).
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: Targeted legal/regulatory search came back generic

recent_news.summary: May 2026: apologised for Singapore delivery delays citing parcel surge; May 2026 FY2025 results; Vietnam express exit mentioned.

misleading_or_wrong_results: ex-workscargo.com claims 5% cut vs 12% reported by CNA
tracxn lists company as App-based B2C platform (stale)

verdict.reasoning: Identity, layoffs and finance are well covered with strong sources; pay and sentiment for the specific role rely on snippets because review/salary sites are walled.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Shift pattern and overtime for night supervisor
Whether warehouse headcount affected by cuts
